title: EVERY GUN HAS ITS OWN KEY
why: His order: the gun should always go to the same slot on the bar, so the player always presses the same button to get it. Each kind of gun now has its key: 1 pistols (Scav Pistol, Magnum), 2 SMG, 3 rifle, 4 burst carbine, 5 support machine gun, 6 shotgun, 7 marksman guns (Marksman Rifle, Whisper), 8 sniper (Longshot), 9 energy (Meridian Lance). A gun you pick up goes to the key of its kind. If that key already holds a gun of the same kind, the better one by the stat card keeps the key and the other goes to the backpack. A higher rarity of the same gun swaps in at once: if the old one is in your hands, the new one is in your hands and the rounds in the magazine come with it (up to the new magazine). The old rule where a tenth gun took the place of your weakest is gone. You can still drag guns around on the bar; that moves them for this raid only, it does not change the keys. The same holds in DEMO. Next builds: setting the keys in the stash, and the words.
now: Every kind of gun has its own key on the bar, and a better rarity of the gun you hold swaps in at once with your rounds.
